minimal_fix.mipmap_fallback_note: a raster-bucket/mipmap fallback already works for apps that HAVE a raster config; frequent-habits has none, so rasterizing the vector layers is required
minimal_fix.unchanged: raster android:icon, adaptive-icon with a PNG layer or colour bg, and any icon resource with a raster bucket (arsc resolver prefers raster) are byte-identical
